subject: general
question: Which of the following is a work by famous Indian author Khushwant Singh?
solution:
The correct answer is **Train to Pakistan.**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points:__**

__
 
• Truth, Love & A Little Malice is an autobiography of the Indian novelist Khushwant Singh.
 
• Indian author, lawyer, diplomat, journalist, and politician.
 
• He experienced the Partition of India, in 1947, which inspired him to write Train to Pakistan in 1956 (his most well-known novel).
 
• In 1974, he was honored with the Padma Bhushan by India's President.
 
• In 2007, Khushwant Singh was awarded the Padma Vibhushan.
 
• Last Book: The Sunset Club.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• In 1951, Khushwant Singh was hired as a journalist by All India Radio.
 
• In 1956, he was transferred to UNESCO's Department of Mass Communications in Paris.
 
• As an editor for a variety of well-known periodicals and magazines: The Hindustan Times, The National Herald, and The Illustrated Weekly of India.
